rows.grounds: instrumental compound indicating the mantra consisting of twelve syllables
indeclinable indicating the present ritual context
compound naming the form of worship involving a skull
feminine nominative adjective qualifying kapāla+arcā as the second item

items.question: Which second form of worship is prescribed when employing the twelve-syllabled mantra in this context?
premises: The ritual context involves the use of a twelve-syllabled mantra.
A prescribed worship act is to be performed in this context.
That prescribed act is designated as the second.
items.inference: Therefore, when the twelve-syllabled mantra is used here, the second prescribed worship is skull-worship.
items.plain_english: Here, when using the twelve-syllabled mantra, the second worship should be the skull-worship.
